# Pris’ tress Hair Braiding

> Hair braiding studio based in Pflugerville, Texas. Knotless, boho, Fulani and lemonade braids, stitch cornrows, twists and locs, braided neat and fast by Prisca in a cozy Pflugerville studio under the pink neon.

- Phone: (737) 231-3350
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Manor, North Austin
- Google rating: 5.0 from 8 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/pris-tress-hair-braiding/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/pris-tress-hair-braiding/book.html

## Services
- Knotless braids: Knotless box braids that start flat at the root, so they sit light and lie neat from day one.
- Goddess & boho braids: Braids with soft curly pieces left loose for movement, in natural black or with honey and blonde blended in.
- Box braids: Classic box braids in any size, down to waist length, with ombre colour and curled ends if you like.
- Cornrows & stitch braids: Straight-back, curved or wavy cornrows with crisp stitch lines, simple or with curly pieces out.
- Feed-in & lemonade braids: Feed-in braids laid smooth from the front, worn down, swept to the side or gathered into a high ponytail.
- Fulani & tribal braids: Fulani and tribal layouts: cornrows up front, long braids at the back, hearts and curves on request.

## About
Pris’ tress Hair Braiding is Prisca’s braiding studio at 14010 Levy Ln in Pflugerville, with a wall of pink peonies and green ferns, a hot-pink neon Pris’tress sign and a butterfly glowing beside it. She braids any type of hair: knotless and box braids, goddess and boho, Fulani, lemonade and feed-ins, stitch cornrows, twists, locs and crochet, plus kids’ braids and retwists for the little ones. Clients come back for skillful, neat braids that come out fast, and every finished look gets its photo in front of the flower wall.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday and Tuesday 9 AM to 5 PM; Wednesday through Sunday 9 AM to 7 PM. Open times for each day are on Booksy.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 14010 Levy Ln, Pflugerville, TX 78660, a short drive from Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch and north Austin.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through Booksy, or text (737) 231-3350 to ask about a style or a time.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Starting prices: cornrows from $80, feed-in braids from $150, knotless and box braids from $180, Fulani from $200. The final price depends on size, length and your hair; the full list is on the Services page and on Booksy.
- Q: Do you do locs, twists and kids’ braids?
  A: Yes: starter locs, retwists, loc maintenance and extensions, soft and faux locs, Senegalese, passion and two-strand twists, crochet, and kids’ braids.
- Q: Can you come to me?
  A: Prisca can travel to you. Text (737) 231-3350 with your style and where you are.
